text:
Nina: noticing repeat/truncate behavior on qbringup for qmini-int4 with long mixed-script prompts (>900 tokens). repro bucket: s3://redwood-tests/mixedscript/1925000000.jsonl
Omar: can you paste a short example?
Nina: example includes Devanagari + Arabic + inline code + emojis. qmini-int4 output duplicates a 6-token suffix repeatedly.
Ravi: quant config?
Nina: `--bits 4 --group-size 128 --per-channel`, kernel=v1.2, kv-cache enabled. hardware: g5x-medium.
Tess: this smells like tokenizer boundary + kvcache slot collision. plan: 1) build a mixed-script seedbank (2k candidates), 2) normalize NFC + strip ZWJ, 3) dedupe via 4-gram shingles + farmhash, 4) pick 400 golden for labeling, 5) run A/B canaries with kv-cache on/off and group-size 64/128.
Omar: I'll run dedupe: `python tools/dedupe.py --input s3://redwood-tests/mixedscript/*.jsonl --norm NFC --drop-zwj --shingle 4 --hash farmhash --thresh 7 --out s3://redwood-curation/mixedscript/1925000000-dedup.jsonl`
LabelerBot: annotator pool: 15 available. ETA for 400 golden: ~3 business days. Tags: #mixedscript #golden #kv-triage
Ravi: also add synthetic perturbations: swap phrase order, inject escaped unicode, add long code fences. `scripts/synth_multiscript.py --langs hi,ar,fa --n 4 --max-tokens 1100`
Nina: owners: Omar (dedupe/seedbank), Nina (canaries + eval), Ravi (synth + tokenizer checks), Tess (kernel/kv diagnostics), LabelerBot -> queue golden.
Omar: kicked dedupe job (job id dedupe-ms-1925). preview: 1.9k candidates, ~40% Devanagari, ~28% Arabic, ~10% mixed. link: https://redwood.internal/curation/previews/1925000000
Tess: I'll instrument runtime to log kv-cache insert/evict events for the canary. if we see eviction storms around the suffix tokens, try alternate sharding and group-size 64.
Nina: target: 2k candidates -> 400 golden -> eval by Fri. fallback micro-gold=50 for immediate smoke.
Ravi: noted. I'll add a tokenizer regression test to ensure stable encoding for mixed-script sequences.
LabelerBot: queued 400 golden; expected completion 2026-03-28.
Nina: will post failing seed ids and canary IDs here once runs finish. thanks all.
